description: BKY-VARIANT-UNIFY — shared i18n-variant deployability vectors. Single source of truth for the rule that decides whether an i18n/{lang} variant is structurally bakeable. Replayed by bakery.i18n.variant.VariantDeployability (plugin) and by com.cheroliv.deploy.VariantDeployability (cheroliv.com site host). Both hosts MUST produce these exact expectations. Do not fork.

vectors.name: a variant carrying every reference template is deployable
a missing reference template makes the variant undeployable
missing templates are reported sorted for a deterministic report
a message bundle co-located in the reference is not a template
a directory in the reference is not a template
ftl and html are templates, other files are not
